heard: Sons of Ullah, stand in the light. Aaron, Han, he'll keep the sight. Rizzi walks where the promise leads. Heads of the fathers in their knees. Chosen men from the tribe of Asher. Mighty warriors who will never falter. 26,000 for the fight Leaders among the leaders bright Enroll for service in the war The tribe of Asher stands once more Heads of their houses, strong and true The chosen men, the people live Bye.
